interpretation_boundaries: These are error spectra of prediction minus GT, not motion spectra.
Energy shares describe squared error, not an additive MPJPE decomposition or achievable improvement.
DC is each six-second clip/joint mean error, not evidence of a universal sensor bias or long-term drift.
W1/W3 CV centers come from each model own cache; center differences do not isolate a causal prior effect.
No multi-seed experiment; bootstrap intervals are conditional on these trained models.
Frequency concentration does not show a low-frequency training loss works; oldK8 multiscale0.03 result was negative.

review.result: Saved prediction/GT norms and global rotation errors matched each saved evaluation row; Parseval, centroid/trend energy identities and bootstrap recomputation passed. Training and long50 diagnostics independently reviewed.

long_full_interval_spectrum.scope: Full saved first-emission sequences within each continuous annotated interval; no interval stitching.
long_full_interval_spectrum.aggregation: Equal intervals; average absolute band energies, then form shares. DC means the entire20.9-118s interval average, not the6s D400 average.
